/            Filter Mode
?            Help
Ctrl-D       Delete [dangerous]
Ctrl-S       Save
Ctrl-Space   Mark Range
Ctrl-W       Toggle Wide
Ctrl-Z       Toggle Faults
Ctrl-\       Marks Clear
Enter        Filter
Esc          Filter Reset
Shift-A      Sort Age
Shift-K      Sort Kind
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-R      Sort Ready
Shift-S      Sort Status
d            Describe
e            Edit [dangerous]
key-272      Help
q            Filter Reset
space        Mark
y            YAML
